name: Sonia Judit
original_name: ソニア・ユーディット
source: A female knight with an ironclad defense. She has been named the 'Goddess of Shields' and has single-handedly defended the city from a group of demon. She has a dignified personality that abandoned her womanhood.
translation: A female knight with an ironclad defense. She has been named the 'Goddess of Shields' and has single-handedly defended the city from a group of demon. She has a dignified personality that abandoned her womanhood.
